opening_rule: Sealed results are evaluated once after development is closed; failed gates cannot be repaired by modifying sealed membership.
preconditions: candidate manifest is complete and SHA-256 frozen
source files or lawful retrieval manifests are complete
strata and mode policies are assigned without using DERD or baseline results
code, metrics, noninferiority margin, and abstention gates are frozen
promotion_rule: C17 cannot reach confirmatory status without a valid seal, complete data, qualifying population, and cross-class evidence.
selection_algorithm: Within each frozen stratum, sort unique star IDs by SHA256(seed:stratum:star_id); first five become sealed_holdout, remaining qualifying stars become development.
